summary: Created a 4-phase plan giving reconcile-task-status.sh a three-way handoff-status classification: exact match permits, on-enum terminal mismatch refuses unchanged, and any value carrying no terminal claim (off-vocabulary, empty, unparseable, or in_progress) permits with a mandatory loud diagnostic naming the offending value and the six legal values. Phase 2 consolidates the partial branch's inline duplicate onto the shared helper; Phase 3 adds a fixture-driven regression suite asserting the parity bar; Phase 4 runs the full gate and rule-compliance sweep.

artifacts.summary: 4-phase implementation plan: helper rewrite with recorded rationale, partial-branch consolidation, regression suite, final gate

decisions_made: Adopted the research report's core design: off-vocabulary status treated as equivalent to a missing handoff (permit, deferring to artifact evidence) with a mandatory loud diagnostic

REFINEMENT beyond the report: in_progress stays in the permit bucket but gets DISTINCT diagnostic wording, never off-schema/malformed framing, because system-defect-discrimination.md's OFF_SCHEMA_STATUS row states verbatim that in_progress is a valid non-terminal marker and not a violation
On-enum terminal mismatches (blocked/partial/failed/cross-phase success) continue to refuse exactly as today -- no relaxation
Empty/absent .status and unparseable handoff JSON land in the permit default, matching the missing-handoff branch
partial branch's inline duplicate consolidated onto handoff_permits_promotion; its on-enum refusals gain a logged line plus an idempotent record_refused_promotion call
Verification requires a throwaway sandbox deploy tree because deploy-root-guard.sh hard-fails when the script runs from the source store; never test by copying into the repo's real .claude/ tree
File-disjoint from the sibling discrimination-contract task: system-defect-discrimination.md is read for alignment, never edited
dead_ends: Rejected refuse-with-diagnostic-only: preserves the wedge, only adds visibility
Rejected synonym-normalization table: incomplete by construction, launders malformed writes, risks false-positive promotion
Rejected routing the fix through orchestrate-recover-outcome.sh: different call site, different reader, own documented policy against permissive off-schema fallbacks
